scope: Nine photo gaps from the approved 49-card release; four exact licensed candidates and five unresolved gaps. No publication or outreach authorized.

cards.title: Rembrandtpark
cards.caveat: The archive description explicitly identifies Rembrandtpark, the Wittepoortsbrug viewpoint and July 1986. The photograph visibly includes the park and former nautical school. Historical image only; not evidence of the current park layout.

cards.title: ibis Leiden Centre
cards.caveat: Commons names Ibis Hotel at Stationsplein in Leiden; the ibis facade/sign is visible. Accor confirms Stationsplein 240–242. Exterior photograph only, not a claim about present rooms or amenities.

cards.title: City Hotel Rembrandt
cards.caveat: Commons identifies addresses 8, 10–12 and 14. The hotel website confirms number 10; the Rembrandt sign is visible beneath the tree. The wider streetscape is retained and not presented as a current unobstructed hotel portrait.

cards.title: Kazerne BarBistro
cards.caveat: Commons records Paradijslaan 4, 4a, 6, 6a (municipal monument WN176), within the official Kazerne address 2–8. The complex facade and former Benz sign are visible. Not Constant Rebecque Kazerne; not a current BarBistro interior photograph.

cards.title: Kaafi
cards.reason: No exact openly licensed photo found in name/address searches or Commons within 125 m. Results for other people named Kaafi and generic coffee are unrelated. The official site supplies no reuse permission in the checked page.

cards.title: Koffie Leute
cards.reason: Name/address searches and nearby Commons images did not establish an exact cafe photo. A licensed canal panorama does not identify the premises clearly. Event photos on NMTH have photographer credits but no verified reuse grant.

cards.title: Supernova Hotel
cards.reason: No exact licensed photo found in Commons by name, address or coordinates. The architect credits PION, but no reuse permission was established. Booking/Leonardo images were not copied.

cards.title: The Collector
cards.reason: Commons Haagsche Bluf photographs have licenses, but inspected candidates show Loetje, a mural or the shared courtyard, not an identifiable Collector hotel facade. Nearby coordinates are not proof. The official gallery supplies no verified reuse permission.

cards.title: The Nox Hotel Utrecht
cards.reason: The official FAQ expressly requires permission for commercial use of website/social photographs. Commons Keistraat photographs identify other addresses (3,4,5–7,9,24), not number 8; a broad 1987 streetscape is insufficient as a hotel hero.
